title: Fall of the Berlin Wall

slides.text: the night the berlin wall opened by mistake.
slides.label: berlin, 9.11.1989
slides.image_query: Berlin Wall November 1989 crowd Brandenburg Gate

slides.text: in 1961, east germany built a wall around west berlin.
slides.label: berlin, 1961

slides.text: 28 years later, it planned to ease travel rules.
slides.label: east berlin, 1989

slides.text: asked when, a spokesman read his note: “immediately.”
slides.label: press conference, 18:53

slides.text: it was meant for the next day. crowds came anyway.
slides.label: bornholmer straße, 23:30

slides.text: within a year, germany was one country again.
slides.label: berlin, 3.10.1990

caption: at 23:30, with no orders, guard harald jäger opened the gate at bornholmer straße. the wall had stood for 28 years. 9 november 1989.
